name: Bercianos del Real Camino (Spain)
description: Divided by a broad white band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, yellow at the upper fly and blue at the lower hoist, charged at the upper hoist with a red scallop shell.
history: Municipal flag of Bercianos del Real Camino; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
scallop shell at the upper hoist
